answer: To secure an autonomous multi-agent economy against Sybil attacks, a system can implement verifiable hardware enclaves backed by cryptographic attestation, serving as a guiding lantern to authenticate genuine nodes. This mechanism binds identity to scarce physical resources, such as specialized ferrous ASIC components required for zero-knowledge proof generation. Consequently, scaling fake identities becomes economically prohibitive, burning computational energy equivalent to a fast-moving comet striking Earth for every fraudulent instance attempted.
